metadata.notes: Test suite covers all five features: Channel Management, Real-time Text Messaging, Live Ticker Card Sharing, Push Notifications for Channel Activity, and Content Moderation

test_cases.title: User can browse available channels and see channel details
test_cases.description: Verify that users can view a list of channels with names, topics, and member counts before joining

given: User is logged in to the app
At least 5 public channels exist in the system
when: User navigates to the Chat tab
User views the channel list
then: All available channels are displayed
Each channel shows name, topic description, and current member count
Join button is visible for channels the user hasn't joined

preconditions: User account exists and is authenticated

test_cases.title: User can join a public channel successfully
test_cases.description: Verify that tapping Join on a channel adds the user as a member and opens the thread

given: User is viewing the channel list
Channel 'AAPL Watchers' exists and user is not a member
when: User taps on 'AAPL Watchers' channel
User taps the Join button
then: User is added as a member of the channel
Channel thread view opens showing message history
Channel appears in the user's joined channels list
Member count increments by 1

test_cases.title: Cannot join a channel if already a member
test_cases.description: Verify that Join button is not shown for channels the user has already joined

given: User is already a member of 'AAPL Watchers' channel
when: User views the channel list
then: Join button is not visible for 'AAPL Watchers'
Channel shows 'Joined' indicator instead

preconditions: User is a member of at least one channel

test_cases.title: User can send a text message and see it in the thread
test_cases.description: Verify that typing and sending a message results in it appearing in the channel thread

given: User is a member of 'AAPL Watchers' channel
Channel thread is open
when: User types 'AAPL holding above 225 support' in the compose box
User presses Enter or taps Send
then: Message appears in the thread within 500ms
Message shows sender's name and timestamp
Compose box is cleared

test_cases.title: Message appears for other users in real-time
test_cases.description: Verify that when one user sends a message, other members see it within 500ms

given: User A and User B are both members of the same channel
Both have the channel thread open
when: User A sends message 'Market looking bullish today'
then: User B sees the message appear in their thread within 500ms
Message shows User A as the sender
Timestamp matches send time

test_cases.title: Cannot send empty messages
test_cases.description: Verify that Send button is disabled when message is empty or whitespace-only

given: User has channel thread open
when: Compose box is empty
User attempts to click Send
then: Send button is disabled
No API call is made

test_cases.title: Message delivery latency is under 500ms at p95
test_cases.description: Performance test verifying message latency meets NFR threshold under load

given: Load test environment with 5,000 simulated concurrent WebSocket connections
when: 1,000 messages are sent across 50 channels using load test tool
End-to-end delivery time is measured from send to receipt
then: p50 latency is less than 100ms
p95 latency is less than 500ms
p99 latency is less than 1,000ms
No message loss occurs

test_cases.title: User can attach a ticker card to a message
test_cases.description: Verify that user can search for a ticker and attach it as a card to their message

given: User has channel thread open
AAPL is a valid tradeable symbol
when: User taps the ticker-card icon in compose toolbar
User searches for 'AAPL' in the picker
User selects AAPL from search results
User types 'My entry target:' in the compose box
User taps Send
then: Message appears in thread with text and embedded AAPL ticker card
Ticker card shows symbol, current price, and intraday % change
Card is rendered inline with the message text

test_cases.title: Ticker card price updates every 15 seconds during market hours
test_cases.description: Verify that ticker cards display live-updating prices at 15-second intervals

given: A message with an AAPL ticker card is visible in the channel
Market is open (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET)
when: 15 seconds elapse
Market data updates with new price
then: Ticker card displays the updated price
Price change is reflected in the % change indicator
Update happens without full page refresh

test_cases.title: Cannot attach ticker card for invalid symbol
test_cases.description: Verify that searching for a non-existent ticker shows appropriate error state

given: User has opened the ticker card picker
when: User searches for 'INVALID_SYMBOL_XYZ'
No matching results are returned from market data API
then: Picker shows 'No results found' message
User cannot select or attach a card
Picker remains open for retry

test_cases.title: Ticker card shows stale indicator when market is closed
test_cases.description: Verify that ticker cards display a 'Market Closed' indicator outside trading hours

given: A message with an AAPL ticker card is visible
Current time is outside market hours (before 9:30 AM or after 4:00 PM ET)
when: User views the ticker card
then: Card displays 'Market Closed' badge
Last known price is shown with timestamp
Price does not auto-update

test_cases.title: User receives a push notification when a new message posts in a joined channel
test_cases.description: Verify that a backgrounded user receives a push notification within 5 seconds of a new message in a channel they belong to

given: User has joined 'options-trading' channel
Push notifications are enabled and the app is backgrounded
when: Another member posts a message to the channel
then: User receives a push notification within 5 seconds
Notification shows sender name, channel name, and a message preview

test_cases.title: Tapping a push notification deep-links to the correct channel and message
test_cases.description: Verify that tapping a delivered notification opens the app directly to the triggering channel thread

given: User has received a push notification for 'crypto-news' channel
when: User taps the notification
then: App opens directly to the 'crypto-news' channel thread
The triggering message is visible and highlighted
Unread badge clears for that channel

preconditions: Notification was delivered while app was backgrounded

test_cases.title: Muted channel suppresses push notifications
test_cases.description: Verify that a user who has muted a channel receives no push notifications for new messages there

given: User has muted the 'penny-stocks' channel
when: A new message is posted to 'penny-stocks'
then: No push notification is sent to the user
The message is still visible in-app when the user opens the channel
A muted indicator displays on the channel in the list

test_cases.title: Notification fan-out respects platform rate limits for large channels
test_cases.description: Verify that notification fan-out to a very large channel completes without breaching APNs/FCM rate limits or duplicating sends

given: A channel has 50,000 members with notifications enabled
when: A message is posted and fan-out begins
then: Fan-out completes within 30 seconds
APNs/FCM rate limits are not breached
No duplicate notifications are sent to any member

test_cases.title: Clean message passes moderation and delivers normally
test_cases.description: Verify that a message with no blocked content clears the rule-based moderation check without added user-visible latency

given: User composes a message containing no blocked keywords or pump-and-dump patterns
when: Message is submitted
then: Message passes the rule-based check in under 5ms
Message is delivered to channel members within the existing 500ms budget
moderation_status is set to 'approved'

test_cases.title: Message with blocked keyword is held and not delivered
test_cases.description: Verify that a message matching the blocklist is withheld from channel members and queued for moderator review

given: Message content contains a known blocked keyword
when: Message is submitted
then: Message is held with moderation_status='pending'
Message is not delivered to channel members
Message appears in the moderator review queue

test_cases.title: Moderator approves a held message and it delivers with original timestamp
test_cases.description: Verify that approving a false-positive held message releases it to channel members with its original send time preserved

given: A message is held in the moderator review queue as a false positive
when: Moderator approves the message
then: Message is delivered to channel members
Message displays its original send timestamp, not the approval time

test_cases.title: Three confirmed violations trigger an automatic 7-day suspension
test_cases.description: Verify that a user's third confirmed moderation violation within 30 days automatically suspends them for 7 days

given: A user already has 2 confirmed violations within the last 30 days
when: Moderator confirms (rejects) a 3rd held message from that user
then: Violation count increments to 3
User automatically receives a 7-day suspension
Suspension is logged to the audit trail

preconditions: User has an existing violation history of 2
